gen-dafont-college-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch reads friendly and current, with a lowercase e whose mouth hangs clearly open and ascenders sitting close to the x-height. College, the display heading, draws every curve with no stress at all, so it sits over that plain sans like a bold sign.
gen-dafont-college-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk reads wide-eyed and friendly, its e and a opening up with tall bowls. College, the display heading, brings thick-only outlines against that, and the two make a strong, easy partnership.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sen: Modern and tall in the lowercase, Sen traces each letter with one constant line, and its curves stop before turning inward. College shouts best at display size; Sen does its best quietly in text.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sintony: Sintony reads smooth and chunky through the middle of its lowercase, with no curve clogging up. Over a long page it would stay easy and steady, never tiring.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sofia-sans: College opens with big counters in a tall lowercase, every curve as thick as its stems, and drives the page like a headline should. Sofia Sans takes over after that, with modern rounded sans letters that stay open.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sofia-sans-semi-co: Every curve in College is as thick as a straight stem, which gives the display heading its dynamic, authoritative punch. And Sofia Semi Condensed follows as a plain sans, lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals, with generous entrances into each curve.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sono: College draws its lines like blueprint lettering, one constant stroke with big counters in a tall lowercase. And Sono, a sans with wide default spacing and a lowercase a left ajar, would carry a longer page comfortably.
gen-dafont-college-gf-stack-sans-notch: College, a dynamic display face with every curve as thick as its stems, takes the heading with big counters in a tall lowercase. Stack Sans Notch follows as a plain sans, its open curves and rod-stock strokes keeping the page easy to see into.
gen-dafont-college-gf-stack-sans-text: College leads with a heavy, dynamic look, every curve as thick as a straight stem. Stack Sans Text then carries the body as a plain sans with a marker-like line, and a modest size lets its big-bodied lowercase breathe.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sulphur-point: Every curve in College is as thick as a straight stem, giving it a dynamic, authoritative look that earns its keep big and short. And Sulphur Point backs it up as a sans with distinct open gaps and bulky lowercase proportions.
